prompts.subject: Subject: a single elegant professional eyebrow tweezer, matte black precision body and brushed stainless-steel slanted gripping tips. Inspired by a high-end beauty editorial closeup of black tweezers: slightly separated slender arms, meticulously machined metal edges, tactile fine matte finish. Show the entire tweezer including joined lower end, tips pointing up, object occupying about 78 percent of canvas height. No surrounding tools.
prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE premium photorealistic studio product photograph for a refined boutique aesthetics clinic website hero, not a collage. Actual transparent alpha background, no solid color, no checkerboard drawn into image, no environment or pedestal. Square canvas. One isolated object fully inside the frame with generous margins, centered, tilted slightly 12 degrees from vertical. Luxury macro product photography, precise physically credible construction, finely resolved materials, soft warm studio key light from upper left, restrained silver highlights, matte charcoal details, elegant understated aesthetic suitable over warm ivory #f3efe9. No text, no logo, no watermark, no hands, no people, no packaging, no extra props. This belongs to a coordinated three-image series; consistent lighting, restrained color, photographic realism and visual scale.
